messages:
Marta K: FYI customer ACME reported p99 errors up to 6.2s on dedicated-north pool since 09:03 UTC. They see attach spikes and 429s from routing. Ticket #2457 escalated.
Sam W: Looking at metrics — dedicated-north pool at 98% alloc, attach latency p99 3.6s, request p99 6.1s. Autoscaler didn't kick because `scale_window` waited; also hit per-tenant GPU quota.
Chen L: Is this same as the warmup/coldgpu we saw last week? Any detach backlog?
Ian O'Neill: Not identical — here attach processes are stuck in `gpu-init` longer. Logs show `kms: timeout` for some instances followed by retries.
Rebecca: Support notes include customer load pattern (sustained spikes from batch jobs) and they pinned model to v1-large causing higher memory use.
Alex P: Repro steps: I hit the pool with a 300 qps synthetic, calls to /v1/generate start returning 429s then 500s after queue overflow. Attach traces: [link]
Marta K: Can someone confirm if dedicated autoscaler honored `burst_capacity`? We have burst disabled for this customer.
oncall-bot: Incident created INC-2001 assigned to eng-sre. Pager sent to @Sam W @Chen L
Sam W: Quick mitigation — I've increased the pool target from 40 -> 60 GPUs for dedicated-north (manual). We'll monitor.
Chen L: Why manual? Autoscaler logs show `scale_decision: suppressed` due to `quota_check_failed`: true. Cloud quota for GPUs is at limit.
Ian O'Neill: Cloud quota request in progress but not approved yet. For immediate, we can fallback traffic to hosted-small model variant with lower GPU memory and faster attach behavior.
Rebecca: Customer is sensitive about data locality. Need to get approval before redirecting.
Alex P: Proposal: 1) temporary manual capacity add (done), 2) enable prewarm for this customer's pool (start prewarm job), 3) reduce default attach timeout to avoid long kv-cache stalls, 4) short-term fallback route to hosted-small with consent.
Marta K: Action items: Sam to monitor capacity and revert scale if stable, Chen to follow quota ticket, Ian to coordinate hosted fallback details with product and privacy, Rebecca to draft customer message.
Sam W: Monitoring dashboard: `https://grafana/redwood/dedicated-north?from=-30m` shows p95 dropping from 2.1s to 1.4s after manual scale (few mins) but p99 still at 3.8s — likely leftover cold GPUs.
Chen L: Logs for one problematic GPU attach:
```:
[2026-03-15T09:02:17Z] attach-start instance=i-0abcde
[2026-03-15T09:02:22Z] gpu-init status=mount-kms error=timeout
[2026-03-15T09:02:37Z] gpu-init status=retry count=3
[2026-03-15T09:03:05Z] attach-complete latency=48s
```
Ian O'Neill: That `mount-kms` timeout is new. Could be KMS regional throttling. Any recent KMS client change?
Alex P: We rolled a KMS client bump 2 days ago (timeout default increased). Rolling back now to test.
support-bot: Customer notified: "We've added capacity and are investigating KMS timeouts. We'll update in 30m." Ticket #2457
Marta K: Can we get a short repro runbook so support can collect right logs next time? Add `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"input":"long prompt"}'` against their route, capture attach_id and share `kubectl logs` output.
Chen L: I'll add a small script to reproduce attach churn and push to ops-scripts: `/ops/repro/dedicated/attach-storm.sh` — it'll run 60 concurrent attaches with `--pin-model v1-large`.
Rebecca: Customer reply: "we can't redirect to hosted due to compliance". They asked about ETA for quota increase.
Ian O'Neill: ETA uncertain. For now we should: a) keep additional manual capacity up, b) schedule warm pool with prewarmed images (30% of peak), c) implement fast-fail for KMS mount after 10s and fallback to retry on next instance to avoid long stalls.
Sam W: I'm adding a temporary flag on autoscaler to ignore `quota_check_failed` for emergency (only for infra admins). Will document and remove after incident.
Marta K: Please also add a postmortem doc template and assign owners. I'll open a postmortem PR.
Alex P: After rolling back KMS client, attach latency improved on test: p99 -> 1.9s. Reproductions on staging show KMS client change was the culprit.
Chen L: Patch note: reverting KMS bump and enabling prewarm job for dedicated-north. Also will add better metric `attach_kms_latency_ms` and alert when >5000ms.
Marta K: Great. Closing loop: customer updated, capacity manual for 4hrs, support to monitor and re-open if they see regressions. We'll run full RCA and postmortem.
Ian O'Neill: FYI follow-ups: open PRs #718 (revert kms client), #719 (prewarm job), #720 (autoscaler emergency flag). Assign reviews.
Sam W: Thanks everyone. :heart:
